end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of 2D shapes through examples and explanations.
Identified that a square has four sides and four corners.
Explained corners as places where two lines meet and distinguished closed from open shapes.
Counted corners accurately in all 3 recorded attempts.
Some shape identification and side-counting responses were unaided correct; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, naming shapes from these features, and noticing whether a shape is closed. Ayaan explained the method using lines and meeting points, and corrected the square-counting mix-up during the lesson. At home, ask them to draw or find closed shapes and touch-count each side and corner once.
